senses.gloss: f. (עָרָה II) thread on the shuttle used for the woof, bobbin.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 21:1">Kel. XXI, 1</cite> <he>ע׳ שאינו עתיד וכ׳</he> a bobbin which the weaver does not intend to shoot back again.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 4</cite> <he>אִירָה</he>.—Pl. <he>עִירִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>אִירִין</he>, v. Rashi a. l.).—V. <cite ref="A01602"><he>אִירָא</he></cite>.
